section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2000
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 2000 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.5.6 The cause-wise analysis of un-natural deaths revealed that 65.8 percent deaths in Nagaland and Manipur were due to 'Road Accidents', 18.3 percent deaths in West Bengal were due to 'Other Railway Accident' 18.9 percent deaths in Gujarat were due to 'Fire Accidents', 33.3 percent deaths in Sikkim were due to 'Falls', 21.5 percent deaths in Daman & Diu, Goa and Tripura were due to 'Drowning' and like-wise making some States/UTs prone to that specific cause.
